statusLine.command: input=$(cat); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '(.context_window.current_usage.input_tokens // 0) + (.context_window.current_usage.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) + (.context_window.current_usage.cache_read_input_tokens // 0)'); total=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.context_window_size // 200000'); awk -v u="$used" -v t="$total" 'function f(n){if(n>=1000000)return sprintf("%.1fM",n/1000000);if(n>=1000)return sprintf("%.1fk",n/1000);return "0k"} BEGIN{printf "%s / %s",f(u),f(t)}'; branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$branch" ] && printf " \033[32m%s\033[0m" "$branch"; :

environment: **Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Default / protected branches**: Default branch: main; Protected branches: none listed; Rulesets: none listed (per gh)
**Source control**: The trusted repo (github.com/AntonNiklasson/dotfiles) and its remote(s) only — no additional orgs configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: any file or store holding personal data, confidential business data, credentials, regulated data, or similarly sensitive material; preserve exact handles when known and share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar — note: this repo is PUBLIC, so per Trusted-repo rules only this repo's own work belongs here; secrets/personal data are never cleared into it regardless of visibility (see .gitignore entries for .envrc)
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment (hyphen/underscore/dot-delimited)
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development (dotfiles/tooling configuration)

**Trusted repo**: ~/.dotfiles (github.com/AntonNiklasson/dotfiles) — PUBLIC: only this repo's own work is OK to commit/push here; content ported or first read from other repos (e.g. sana-ai, albin-hus, github-dashboard, antn.se) is not its own work and stays out; secrets/personal data are never cleared into it
**Org-specific CLIs**: None configured — repo-local tools observed (ya, chk, dotbot) are project scripts, not org CLIs
routine under ~/.dotfiles/ prefix: local dotfile edits, brew/nvim/tmux config changes, install.sh runs
